summary: Frontend-only mobile-first retest passed on preview URL. Fresh onboarding profile successfully completed unavailable-to-available lifecycle for a future schedule day, and Schedule remained stable after reversal.
critical_code_review_comments: In /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx, LogBox.ignoreAllLogs(true) is still suppressing warnings globally, which can hide runtime regressions during QA and production diagnostics.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tested on https://emergent-code-sync.preview.emergentagent.com at mobile viewport 375x667. Fresh profile created by clearing web storage and completing onboarding. Verified: select future day -> tap mark-unavailable-button -> UNAVAILABLE pill + mark-available-button appear; tap mark-available-button -> UNAVAILABLE clears and mark-unavailable-button returns; schedule remained rendered with no detected .error/[class*=error]/[id*=error] nodes.
rca_of_issue: Previous failure was tied to Alert confirmation callback behavior on web preview. Current implementation executes direct reversible actions without Alert callbacks, and lifecycle now works reliably in independent QA.
